title: NSGo game 3D grid map (version 1)
description: GridMapDoc is the root of a versioned YAML modular 3D grid map document referencing a mesh library and placing tiles on an integer 3D lattice.

version.description: Version is the schema version; must be 1.

name.description: Name is an optional human-readable name for the grid map.

origin.description: Origin is the world-space [x, y, z] origin of grid cell (0, 0, 0); omitted defaults to [0, 0, 0].

cellSize.description: CellSize is the world-space [x, y, z] dimensions of one grid cell; omitted defaults to [1, 1, 1].

meshLibrary.description: MeshLibrary is the optional asset path to the glTF 2.0 (.gltf) mesh library supplying named tiles.

boxes.description: Boxes lists non-overlapping filled axis-aligned coordinate box runs placed before individual cells, written in canonical (y, z, x) order.

cells.description: Cells lists individual occupied cells placed in canonical (y, z, x) coordinate order.

GridBoxDoc.description: GridBoxDoc describes an axis-aligned box run of identical tiles placed from Min to Max (inclusive).

min.description: Min is the inclusive minimum integer [x, y, z] grid coordinate of the filled box.

max.description: Max is the inclusive maximum integer [x, y, z] grid coordinate of the filled box; each axis must be >= min.

tile.description: Tile is the name of the tile in the referenced mesh library.

orientation.description: Orientation is the orthogonal cube rotation index in 0..23 (0..3 are 0°, 90°, 180°, 270° around +Y); omitted defaults to 0.

GridCellDoc.description: GridCellDoc describes one occupied cell in a [GridMapDoc].

at.description: At is the discrete integer [x, y, z] grid coordinate of the cell.

tile.description: Tile is the name of the tile in the referenced mesh library.

orientation.description: Orientation is the orthogonal cube rotation index in 0..23 (0..3 are 0°, 90°, 180°, 270° around +Y); omitted defaults to 0.
